Package Composition:
select 
	(select count(*) from modules) as m,
	(select count(*) from classes) as c,
	(select count(*) from functions) as f,
	(select count(*) from constants) as cnst,
	(select count(*) from imports) as imps
Class Details:
select	
	(select count(*) from decorators where class_id is not null) as decorated,
	(select count(*) from classes where is_contextmanager = 1) as contextmanager,
	(select count(*) from classes where is_nested = 1) as nested,
	(select count(*) from classes where has_metaclass = 1) as has_metaclass,
	(select count(*) from classes where is_iterable = 1) as is_iterable,
	(select count(*) from classes where is_iterator = 1) as is_iterator,
	(select count(*) from classes where is_descriptor = 1) as is_descriptor
Functions Details:
select 
	(select count(*) from functions where is_decorated = 1) as decorated,
	(select count(*) from functions where is_generator = 1) as generator,
	(select count(*) from functions where is_async = 1) as async,
	(select count(*) from functions where has_generator_delegation = 1) as has_generator_delegation
Top External Imports:
select 
	coalesce(source || '.','') || name as full_name,
	count(*) as total_count 
from imports 
where full_name not like :mod
group by full_name 
order by total_count desc
LIMIT 20
Top Internal Imports:
select 
	coalesce(source || '.','') || name as full_name,
	count(*) as total_count 
from imports 
where full_name like :mod
group by full_name 
order by total_count desc
LIMIT 20
Top Inherited Classes:
select name, count(*) as total_count
from bases 
group by name
order by total_count desc 
limit 20
Top Decorators:
select name, count(*) as total_count
from decorators
group by name
order by total_count desc 
limit 20
god_modules:
WITH class_count AS (
                                select 
                                m.id as module_id, count(*) as cls_count 
                                from classes c 
                                join modules m ON m.id = c.module_id
                                group by m.id
                            ),
                            func_count AS (
                                select 
                                m.id as module_id, count(*) as func_count 
                                from functions f 
                                join modules m ON m.id = f.module_id
                                group by m.id
                            ),
                            cnst_count AS (
                                select 
                                m.id as module_id, count(*) as cnst_count 
                                from constants cnst 
                                join modules m ON m.id = cnst.module_id
                                group by m.id
                            ),
                            imp_count AS (
                                select 
                                m.id as module_id, count(*) as imp_count 
                                from imports imp 
                                join modules m ON m.id = imp.module_id
                                group by m.id
                            )
SELECT m.name , coalesce(c.cls_count,0) as cls_count, 
			coalesce(f.func_count,0) as func_count, 
			coalesce(cnst.cnst_count,0) as cnst_count, 
			coalesce(imp.imp_count,0) as imp_count,
		coalesce(c.cls_count,0) + coalesce(f.func_count,0)+ coalesce(cnst.cnst_count,0) + coalesce(imp.imp_count,0) as total
FROM modules m 
LEFT JOIN class_count c ON m.id = c.module_id
LEFT JOIN func_count f ON m.id = f.module_id
LEFT JOIN cnst_count cnst ON m.id = cnst.module_id 
LEFT JOIN imp_count imp ON m.id = imp.module_id
ORDER BY total desc
LIMIT 40
_Import Split:
with fname AS (
	select case when source is null then '' else (source||'.') end|| name as full_name,
		source, name
	from imports
	group by full_name
)

select 
	case 
	when INSTR(full_name,'.') = 0 THEN full_name 
	ELSE SUBSTR(full_name,1,INSTR(full_name,'.')-1)
	END as fname,
	count(*) as count
from fname
group by fname
order by count desc
